reviews.title: Activated carbon filter medium delivers as needed
reviews.text: This listing is our third advection-fog demister and the first one specified properly. Activated carbon was the deciding choice, and this listing is listed that way, with activated carbon filters capturing up to 92% of airborne particulates. If your requirement is not filter medium, this listing has no other reason to win.
